programs.description: A young ambitious filmmaker wants to be the best horror director in Malayalam cinema, aiming to improve the industry even though his father warns him about its constraints.
Narayanankutty boasts that he is Mala's fiancé, the daughter of a rich businessman. Things take a turn when she approaches him in the guise of a news reporter and asks him about this affair.
A curated collection of various hilarious scenes and snippets from different movies, starring renowned actors, played consecutively.
Rahul, an aspiring film director, is advised to write a gangster-based story. However, things become complicated when he decides to discreetly follow Arumuga, a gangster, for inspiration.
